The presence of multiple pathways linking Idarubicin to Mitoxantrone, and subsequently to the target syndrome, suggests a broader role in the treatment of this condition. The integration of these pathways highlights the importance of Mitoxantrone in the therapeutic management of this disease, and the potential for Idarubicin to be part of a broader treatment strategy.
